steps.npc: Do you want me to make some planks for you? I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany logs. Or would you like to buy some other housing supplies?

options.text: Yes, please make me some planks.

steps.player: Yes, please make me some planks.

steps.text: If the player does not have the chosen log in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Sawmill operator
steps.text: You'll need to bring me some more logs.
If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.speaker: Sawmill operator
steps.text: Those planks cost [X] coins. You don't have enough money for all of them.

options.text: What kind of planks can you make?

steps.npc: I can make planks from wood, oak, teak and mahogany. I don't make planks from other woods as they're no good for making furniture.
Wood and oak are all over the place, but teak and mahogany can only be found in a few places like Karamja and Etceteria.

options.text: Can I buy some housing supplies?

steps.npc: Well come back when you want some. You can't get good quality planks anywhere but here!
